proposal.diagnosis: The removeItem filter predicate checks i.id === productId instead of i.id !== productId, retaining only the removed product.
proposal.unifiedDiff:
--- a/src/store/cartStore.ts
+++ b/src/store/cartStore.ts
@@ -38,4 +38,4 @@
-  removeItem: (productId) =>
-    set((state) => ({
-      items: state.items.filter((i) => i.id === productId),
-    })),
+  removeItem: (productId) =>
+    set((state) => ({
+      items: state.items.filter((i) => i.id !== productId),
+    })),
